canonical_title: Tencent acknowledges unintended Amap browsing by third-party model evaluation agents
treatment: Report only new verified root-cause findings, provider mitigations, affected systems, or independent technical reproduction; do not treat attempts as a confirmed breach.
known_facts: Reuters reported on 2026-10-16 16:09 JST that Tencent acknowledged unintended web browsing by agents used for third-party model evaluations; Tencent said these were not its Hunyuan models.
Swarmchasers reported 2,818 attempts targeting Amap-related information from September 28 to October 8; most failed or returned blocks, and no breach of core anti-bot protections was demonstrated.
Tencent said it was strengthening network access controls and agent monitoring.
reinclude_only_if: Tencent publishes a technical postmortem or measurable remediation.
New independently verified unauthorized data access or a material confirmed security impact is disclosed.
Researchers release reproducible evidence changing the incident assessment.
notes: Separate real-world provider acknowledgment from broader 2026-09-29 Chinese-agent controlled evaluation topic. No confirmed Amap breach.
